body:
XL original-model progress — 12 October 2026, checkpoint v7

Fixed scope: 521 XL originals; 233 installed in the catalogue / 288 remaining. Zero new installations in this checkpoint. 232 installed assets have exact current installed-review bindings; West Wing 26195 remains an installed legacy compound-acceptance follow-up. Do not narrow the remaining goal to a working subset.

Whole-map counts: 346,108 source forms; 4,516 enhanced (4,498 government + 18 other); 212,669 government-eligible forms; 6,649 native catalogue entries. These are model/form counts, not unique physical buildings.

New completed evidence, committed and pushed:
- Upton: exact existing guard-column job d9a167b3fa8775af3a17c6355616a3181e483a7e78d97554ff595d8654fd333e (8,528 references) and source-role residual job 833861983a261e8ba85626f3fc794042d76c8426b2b3fc48db6363f6d3efc8b3 (8,513 references), independently read back from pinned Neon. ROOT viewed all seven original-source context images. Tower and main podium remain whole separate original sources; secondary podium remains foreign. Commit a65c646b1. A two-original terrain nomination has passed 13 actual adverse fixtures and import/schema/literal-closure preflight; its one bounded constructor run is authorised, with unchanged ground-gap/burial/roof guards.
- Nam Fung 79099: source-bound BASIC main-body interbody-role job e395c21a321ec72c2ab95b62adce8a81adaf2894806933b8135e17ed26c41a40 (1,021 references), independently read back from pinned Neon. Exact graph reaches 457 of 569 bodies; ROOT viewed five complete-source images and reviewed the remaining 112 unchanged bodies as descriptive, nonbridging visual-source details. This is source-role evidence, not installation approval. Commit 3e5f747bb. A minimal caller for fresh identity, placement, neighbour/native, runtime, foundation and actual BASIC support/dependency checks is ready for review; it reuses completed finite and contact evidence.
- Southside: actual production-ground job 73dc1d5f866d4a85ddef92ace0d2238844b355ed5aa1061398ce0fb116a811aa (8,177 references), independently read back from pinned Neon. Candidate preserves 24,580 terrain faces but causes 16 genuine increased-neighbour-ground-gap failures: 311758–311763, 315026–315028, 328110, 328306, 328308–328310, 330243–330244. Commit 1c2846d44. These failures are neither corruption nor approved compound ownership. Saved source-face attribution and a genuine repair are next; no costly full candidate qualification on this known failing proposal.

Original government building geometry and 1× placement remain unchanged. Zero AI geometry modelling; no optimisation processing, variant approval or derived-asset publication. Installed-catalogue flags alone are not authoritative review evidence: reuse exact current Neon/source/placement acceptance, reconcile stale bookkeeping, and recheck genuine gaps rather than blanket-approve or redo every installed model.

All 288 absent XL originals remain in the active goal. Genuine unfixable cases require exact source-specific evidence and persisted reasons.
